# LIN4CRE

Independent software, browser tools and games by David Linacre in South Yorkshire.

## Selected work
- /tools — Browser utilities and a developer playground. The optional AI feature uses an external service.
- /osint — Searchable open-source research directory.
- /music-videos — Proper Mad music-video collection, with playback on an external host.
- /games — Three self-hosted browser games: Circuit, Decrypt and Gridlock.
- /about — About David Linacre.
- /contact — Contact form.

Source: https://github.com/LIN4CRE/linacre.site
